newsitem.title: UK: Chemring soars on Beeson Gregory upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Chemring soars on Beeson Gregory upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Chemring Group Plc rose sharply on Wednesday as brokerage Beeson Gregory raised its recommendation from "hold" to "buy" after a meeting with the management of the engineering group.
By 1330 GMT the stock was up 22-1/2p or 29 percent to 100p. "They have had a difficult year", Julian Morse at Beeson Gregory said.
Morse forecast pre-tax profit in the current financial year, ending September 30, to drop to 4.3 million stg from 8.1 million stg but saw no further exceptional charges.
"I don't see any exceptional items coming and on this basis it looks attractive", he said.
Earlier this year Chemring warned that it would post a loss of no more than 2 million stg before taxes and exceptional items.
Apart from a better order intake, the appointment of the new chairman, Ken Scobie, announced today by Chemring, would fuel hopes for a lasting recovery, Morse said.
